The '''2004–05 season''' of the '''[[Eredivisie]]''' started on August 13, 2004, and ended on May 22, 2005. The title was won by [[PSV Eindhoven|PSV]]. [[FC Den Bosch]] and [[De Graafschap]] were relegated to the [[2005–06 Eerste Divisie|Eerste Divisie]] at the end of the season.

==Promoted teams==
*[[FC Den Bosch]] (Eerste Divisie champion)
*[[De Graafschap]] (6th, promoted through playoffs)

==Relegated at the end of the season==
*[[De Graafschap]] (17th, relegated through playoffs)
*[[FC Den Bosch]] (18th)
